name: u2
task:
STRESS FIX (was fatal): TodayEntryFeed cannot simply become a ListView.builder. It sits inside a Column inside a SingleChildScrollView, where ListView.builder throws on unbounded height and shrinkWrap builds every child anyway while discarding cacheExtent. Convert TodayScreen to a CustomScrollView in BOTH layout branches: header, mood banner and feed eyebrow as SliverToBoxAdapter, the feed as SliverList.builder, cacheExtent on the CustomScrollView.
EntryCard gains a preview flag: in the feed it renders roughly the first 1200 characters plus the first photo with a fade and a Read more affordance; in the full-note surface it renders everything.
STRESS FIX (was fatal): there is currently NO full-note read surface. Day detail builds the SAME EntryCard inside a 520x520 box, so a long note can be read nowhere in the app. Day detail's tile passes preview:false, and EntryCard gains an onTap that opens that entry's day detail scrolled to it.
acceptance: TodayScreen builds a CustomScrollView with a non-zero cacheExtent in BOTH the stacked and withRail branches whose entry feed is a SliverList.builder (a 50-entry day builds only the entries near the viewport, and no "Vertical viewport was given unbounded height" is thrown), EntryCard with preview:true renders at most ~1200 characters of note text plus only the first photo behind a fade with a Read more control while preview:false renders the whole note and every photo, day detail's tile passes preview:false, and tapping a feed card opens that entry's day detail with the tapped entry scrolled into view.

file_notes.lib/features/today/today_screen.dart: Replace the shared `main` Column + SingleChildScrollView in both TodayLayout.stacked and TodayLayout.withRail branches with a CustomScrollView carrying an explicit cacheExtent, whose slivers are SliverPadding(EdgeInsets.all(20)/all(24)) wrapping SliverToBoxAdapter(TodayHeader), SliverToBoxAdapter(MoodBannerForDate), SliverToBoxAdapter(TodayFeedEyebrow) and the sliver-producing TodayEntryFeed; the rail Row, DashedDivider and TodayRightRail are otherwise unchanged.
file_notes.lib/features/today/today_entry_feed.dart: TodayEntryFeed stops returning a Column and becomes sliver-producing: SliverList.builder over entries with ValueKey<String>(entry.id) and findChildIndexCallback, and SliverToBoxAdapter for the error / empty-state / not-yet-loaded branches; the 12pt gap moves into the item builder; FadeIn is passed animate:false (or dropped) so a card re-entering cacheExtent does not re-fade or spin up a fresh AnimationController; TodayEntryTile gains the feed date, passes preview:true to EntryCard, and supplies an onTap that calls showDayDetail(context, date: date, focusEntryId: entry.id).
file_notes.lib/features/entry_cards/entry_card.dart: Add `final bool preview` (default false, so every existing call site keeps full rendering) and `final VoidCallback? onTap`; wrap the StickerCard in a GestureDetector/InkWell when onTap is non-null; _body() routes EntryType.text to NotePreview when preview is true and NoteBody when false; the InlinePhotoStrip is given maxVisible:1 when preview is true.
file_notes.lib/features/entry_cards/cards/note_prev: NEW, alongside the existing cards/note_body.dart and cards/photo_strip.dart. Holds `notePreviewCharLimit` (1200), a pure `notePreviewOf(String source, {int limit})` returning the truncated text plus a wasTruncated flag, the `noteReadMoreLabel` string, and a `NotePreview` widget that renders the truncated text in the same serif body style, applies a bottom fade (ShaderMask with a LinearGradient) and shows the Read more affordance only when truncation actually happened.
file_notes.lib/features/entry_cards/cards/photo_str: InlinePhotoStrip gains an optional `int? maxVisible` applied AFTER the existing non-mutating sortOrder sort, so preview cards show only the first photo; the default (null) keeps today's render-all behaviour.
file_notes.lib/features/entry_cards/entry_cards.dar: Add `export 'cards/note_preview.dart';` to the barrel, keeping the existing alphabetical ordering (it lands between note_body.dart and photo_strip.dart).
file_notes.lib/features/day_detail/day_detail_entry: Pass `preview: false` explicitly to EntryCard so day detail is the full-note read surface and stays so even if the EntryCard default is later flipped; no onTap is supplied because this IS the destination.
file_notes.lib/features/day_detail/day_detail_panel: Add an optional `String? focusEntryId`; replace the `shrinkWrap: true` ListView.separated at :141 (which builds every child and discards cacheExtent) with a bounded, genuinely lazy ListView.separated/CustomScrollView driven by an owned ScrollController, keeping the existing findItemIndexCallback; on first settle, scroll the focused entry into view (GlobalKey + Scrollable.ensureVisible, or an index-derived offset); relax the hard maxHeight so a long note is readable rather than read through a ~340pt porthole.
showDayDetail gains an optional named `String? focusEntryId` forwarded to DayDetailPanel; the isCaptureDateKey guard, barrier and transition are unchanged. The parameter must stay OPTIONAL so the function remains assignable to calendar_screen.dart's OpenDayDetail typedef without editing it.
file_notes.test/features/today/today_entry_feed_tes: Every `pumpToday(tester, const TodayEntryFeed(date: ...))` must host the now-sliver feed inside a CustomScrollView; add coverage that a long entry list builds only near-viewport children (lazy) and that a card tap routes to day detail with the tapped entry id.
file_notes.test/features/today/today_screen_test.da: Add assertions that both TodayLayout.stacked and TodayLayout.withRail build a CustomScrollView with a non-zero cacheExtent and pump without a viewport-unbounded-height exception; existing greeting/date/mood/feed text expectations stay.
file_notes.test/features/entry_cards/entry_card_tes: Add cases for preview:true (NotePreview rendered, long text truncated, Read more present, exactly one MediaImage in the strip) versus preview:false (NoteBody rendered, full text, all photos) and for onTap firing; the existing NoteBody/StickerCard cases keep passing on the false default.
file_notes.test/features/entry_cards/cards/note_pre: NEW, mirroring test/features/entry_cards/cards/note_body_test.dart. Covers notePreviewOf at, below and above the 1200-char limit, that Read more is absent for short notes and present for truncated ones, and that the fade renders.
file_notes.test/features/entry_cards/cards/photo_st: Add a case that maxVisible:1 renders one MediaImage and that it is the lowest-sortOrder photo, and that the default still renders all photos in sortOrder.
file_notes.test/features/day_detail/day_detail_entr: Assert the tile hands EntryCard preview:false, so a long note renders in full in day detail.
file_notes.test/features/day_detail/day_detail_pane: Add coverage that a long note renders in full (not truncated) and that opening with focusEntryId scrolls that entry into view; existing heading/mood/count/add-note/edit/delete cases must keep passing against the de-shrinkWrapped list.
file_notes.test/features/day_detail/show_day_detail: Add a case that showDayDetail forwards focusEntryId to DayDetailPanel and that omitting it preserves today's behaviour.

name: u5
task:
Define a NoteEditor interface with SingleFieldNoteEditor as the default implementation from the day it lands, so the fallback is a boolean rather than a rewrite.
Replace the raw EditableText with a TextField, which restores selection handles, the copy/paste toolbar, the magnifier and painted selection - all absent today because neither selectionControls nor contextMenuBuilder is passed, so Flutter disposes the selection overlay.
Drive it with MarkdownStyleController extends TextEditingController overriding buildTextSpan, LENGTH-PRESERVING BY CONSTRUCTION: markers stay VISIBLE and de-emphasised rather than hidden. No WidgetSpan, no sentinel character, no zero-size run, no TextSpan.recognizer. That single constraint removes an entire class of caret bug.
Four framework defences, all mandatory: (1) assert inside buildTextSpan that the built span's plain-text length equals the value's text length - the framework raises nothing when this breaks and every caret offset past the break is then silently wrong; (2) a test that FAILS THE BUILD if 'recognizer:' appears under the editor directory; (3) spellCheckConfiguration null and stylusHandwritingEnabled false, with the reason recorded, because EditableTextState.buildTextSpan short-circuits past the controller override in both states and styling silently vanishes; (4) the IME composing underline reapplied by hand over value.composing, because overriding buildTextSpan drops it.
A liveStyleLimit of 6000 characters past which buildTextSpan returns one plain span. NO text truncation anywhere - never a LengthLimitingTextInputFormatter in an app whose job is capturing text.
STRESS FIX: this is meant to be a feature-rich Markdown editor and no formatting affordance was specified at all. Add a compact format bar - bold, italic, heading, list, quote, link - above the keyboard on compact screens and in the composer header on desktop, each toggling markers at the selection.
STRESS FIX: add an explicit Undo control. Flutter's UndoHistory is bound to keyboard shortcuts and Android has no Ctrl-Z, so every 'undo restores it' claim in this design is desktop-only without it.
acceptance: `flutter analyze` and `flutter test` pass with the composer's writing surface a `TextField` behind a `NoteEditor` seam whose default `SingleFieldNoteEditor` + `MarkdownStyleController` asserts `span.toPlainText().length == value.text.length` on every `buildTextSpan`, keeps markers visible and dimmed, returns one plain span above 6000 characters, never truncates, and sits under a format bar whose bold/italic/heading/list/quote/link and Undo controls each mutate or restore `controller.text` on tap — including a new test that fails the build when `recognizer:` appears anywhere under `lib/features/capture/text/editor/`.

file_notes.lib/features/capture/text/editor/note_ed: NEW. Declares the `NoteEditor` seam: an abstract interface (controller + focus node + undo controller + scroll controller + style/hint config) that both implementations satisfy, plus the single selection point that returns the default implementation. This is the file U10 implements against; it must know nothing about how photos or storage work.
file_notes.lib/features/capture/text/editor/single_: NEW. The day-one default implementation: one `TextField` replacing the raw `EditableText`, passing `selectionControls`/`contextMenuBuilder` (restoring handles, copy/paste toolbar, magnifier and painted selection), `magnifierConfiguration`, `spellCheckConfiguration: null` and `stylusHandwritingEnabled: false` with the reason recorded at the design level, `maxLines: null, minLines: null, expands: true`, `undoController`, and a collapsed/null `InputDecoration` so the existing paper look and hint overlay survive.
file_notes.lib/features/capture/text/editor/markdow: NEW. `MarkdownStyleController extends TextEditingController` overriding `buildTextSpan`, length-preserving by construction: no WidgetSpan, no sentinel, no zero-size run, no `TextSpan.recognizer`; markers stay visible at `Palette.ink34`; `assert(span.toPlainText().length == value.text.length)`; `liveStyleLimit = 6000` past which one plain span is returned; the IME composing underline reapplied by hand over `value.composing` when `withComposing`.
file_notes.lib/features/capture/text/editor/format_: NEW. Pure `TextEditingValue -> TextEditingValue` marker toggles for bold, italic, heading, bullet list, quote and link — inline wrap/unwrap at the selection and line-prefix add/remove over the selected lines — each returning a new value with the corrected selection and never mutating its input. Kept free of widgets so it is unit-testable without a pump.

NEW. The compact format bar widget (bold, italic, heading, list, quote, link) plus the explicit Undo control bound to the `UndoHistoryController` via `ValueListenableBuilder<UndoHistoryValue>` for enablement — the Android substitute for Ctrl-Z. Buttons are `canRequestFocus: false` / `skipTraversal: true` so the editor keeps focus and selection across a tap, and the bar exposes a trailing slot that U8 fills with Add photo.
NEW. Barrel re-exporting the five editor files, matching the repo's per-module barrel convention (capture.dart, photo.dart, video.dart, voice.dart, widgets.dart, tokens.dart).
file_notes.lib/design/icons/format_icons.dart: NEW. `FormatGlyph` enum and `CustomPainter`-based glyphs for bold, italic, heading, list, quote, link and undo, following the existing `CaptureIcon`/`CaptureIconPainter` 24-unit viewBox + stroke idiom. Painted glyphs rather than text labels so the bar adds no `find.text` matches that could collide with the composer tests' `find.text('Save')`.
file_notes.lib/features/capture/text/text_composer_: Replace the raw `EditableText` at :293-304 with the `NoteEditor` seam, construct the `MarkdownStyleController`, `UndoHistoryController` and focus node in `initState` and dispose them, and mount the `FormatBar` — in the composer header on the desktop shell, directly above the writing surface (keyboard side) on the compact shell. Keep exactly one editable in the tree so the composer tests' single-match `tester.widget<EditableText>` cast still holds.
file_notes.lib/features/capture/core/capture.dart: Add `export '../text/editor/editor.dart';` alongside the existing text_composer exports so the editor module is reachable through the capture barrel like every other capture submodule.
file_notes.test/features/capture/text/editor/markdo: NEW. Asserts the length-preserving invariant over a fuzz corpus of marker-bearing sources, that markers are styled rather than removed, that a >6000-character value returns a single plain span, that nothing is ever truncated, and that the composing range carries `TextDecoration.underline` when `withComposing: true`.
file_notes.test/features/capture/text/editor/no_rec: NEW. Reads every `.dart` file under `lib/features/capture/text/editor/` from disk (following the `pubspec_fonts_test.dart` / `android_manifest_permissions_test.dart` static-inspection convention) and fails if `recognizer:` appears in any of them — the defect is invisible on macOS and produces 23 render-tree exceptions on Android.
file_notes.test/features/capture/text/editor/format: NEW. Table-driven unit tests for each toggle over collapsed, single-word, multi-word and multi-line selections, in both apply and un-apply directions, asserting the resulting text and selection offsets.

NEW. Widget tests that each bar control changes the buffer at the selection, that the Undo control restores the previous value without any keyboard shortcut, and that a bar tap does not steal focus or collapse the selection.
file_notes.test/features/capture/text/editor/single: NEW. Asserts the mounted `EditableText` has non-null `selectionControls` and `contextMenuBuilder` (so the selection overlay is not disposed), a non-null `selectionColor` after a long-press selection, `spellCheckConfiguration` null, `stylusHandwritingEnabled` false, and that exactly one `EditableText` exists in the composer tree.
